desc: Ideation: derive reduction to shortest common supersequence of the two forced chains R and B; SCS = |R|+|B|-LCS.
Implement parsing, inverse permutations, backward cycle enumeration from X, and reachability check (occupied box off X's cycle ⇒ -1).
Build red chain R and blue chain B as cycle[d], cycle[d-1], ..., cycle[1] with d = farthest occupied distance (excluding X); handle empty chains and balls already at X.
Compute LCS(R,B) via mapping R to indices and strict LIS over B's mapped indices (bisect_left); output len(R)+len(B)-LCS.
Stress-test against brute-force BFS over small cases to confirm the SCS reduction and implementation; sample tests passed.
